mapper.select: SELECT id, normalized_dish_name, display_dish_name, unit, category, ingredient_cost, restaurant_price, restaurant_source, restaurant_source_url, ingredient_basis, observed_at, search_confidence FROM FEED_FOOD_COST_REFERENCE WHERE category = #{category} AND REPLACE(LOWER(unit), ' ', '') = #{normalizedUnit} AND ( normalized_dish_name = #{normalizedDishName} OR normalized_dish_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{normalizedDishName}, '%') OR #{normalizedDishName} LIKE CONCAT('%', normalized_dish_name, '%') ) ORDER BY normalized_dish_name = #{normalizedDishName} DESC, search_confidence DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FEED_FOOD_COST_REFERENCE (normalized_dish_name, display_dish_name, unit, category, ingredient_cost, restaurant_price, restaurant_source, restaurant_source_url, ingredient_basis, observed_at, search_confidence) VALUES (#{normalizedDishName}, #{displayDishName}, #{unit}, #{category}, #{ingredientCost}, #{restaurantPrice}, #{restaurantSource}, #{restaurantSourceUrl}, #{ingredientBasis}, #{observedAt}, #{searchConfidence}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_dish_name = VALUES(display_dish_name), ingredient_cost = VALUES(ingredient_cost), restaurant_price = VALUES(restaurant_price), restaurant_source = VALUES(restaurant_source), restaurant_source_url = VALUES(restaurant_source_url), ingredient_basis = VALUES(ingredient_basis), observed_at = VALUES(observed_at), search_confidence = VALUES(search_confidence)
